title: Bounded spectral unmixing, color/calibration and raster preparation

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only; not complete parameter, numerical or project migration compatibility

implementation.unmix: One shared bounded native producer per actual source tuple/spec. Four independent constraint combinations; support-face SVD with exact dyadic rank and centered simplex contrasts, whole-spectrum NoData, source Infinity rejection, explicit Double output. Fresh precharged input/clip snapshots and source/grid checks on cache hits.
implementation.numerical_admission: MC80 arithmetic; retained singular ratio >=2^-48; useful coefficient-error ceiling1e-8, absolute scale1 for simplex+nonnegative and max(1,coefficient infinity norm) otherwise. Guard before feasibility filtering rejects unresolved global faces. Norm-center ordering precedes uncertainty comparison; lex only for indistinguishable coefficients. Local approximate numerical policies, not universal/global minimum-norm or Google claims.
implementation.dry_run: Actual pinned upstream evaluator proves output component selection/renaming does not prune source operand bands; idempotent band-only propagation blocker.
implementation.color_and_curves: Closed existing scalar Float64 IR for ordered3-channel RGB/HSV, all4 interpolation behaviors and ascending-degree all-band polynomial. Bounded strong-reference scalar sharing and exact-triplet proven-domain reuse retain masks/staged casts without raising caps.
implementation.bands_and_metadata: RE2 rename, half-open slice, first-metadata cat, scalar/array/bundle float/double aliases, actual item ID, numeric independently valid on-grid metadata. Public SDK leading-constant cat fixed in existing addBands path. Actual per-item metadata expansion preserves distinct same-day IDs.
implementation.arrays: Masked rank including scalar0; positional/broadcast rank1 dot with fresh scene/grid checks; append-only fixed padding preserving full-array mask and physical Float32/Double stage. Added pads require a concrete single-scene grid.

original_raw_probes.remaining_rejection: Raw Image.arrayPad is a typed array and cannot be directly exported. Its explicit arrayGet consumer compiles and computes in exact-entry tests. Original probe expression was retained unchanged.

exact_new_entry_probes.scope: Pinned Python SDK1.7.49; typed arrayPad scalarized; unmix native values separately checked, never replaced by a Python solver

workflow.source_binding: Compiler positional bands band0..2 and actual selected source arrays checked exactly before consuming real native outputs
workflow.independent_reference: Exact Fraction mixtures and colorsys/Fraction calibration, independent of compiler output

native.scope: Trusted actual GeoTrellis tile kernels plus bridge/dry-run tests, not full Spark or deployment

read_only_numerical_review.status: no remaining blocker in frozen reviewed scope
